final.counts_scope: Proof objects only; excludes term/formula payloads, context and history

proof_cost.scope: Only the winning final certificate or the retained best partial proof; not peak search memory

native_timing.scope: Transition time includes prefix restoration and tactic checking; finalization includes compilation and kernel checking. Measurements are diagnostic overhead.

branch_ranker.features_scope: All ordered native goal texts and prefix depth; unobserved per-branch costs/budgets stay missing

model_advice_memory.scope: One search; exact full ordered goal tuple; one fixed model provider.
model_advice_memory.retained_bytes_unit: UTF-8 JSON goal payload; excludes Python object overhead.
model_advice_memory.previous_model_call_unit: One-based actual forward-pass batch count, not provider decode-attempt ordinal.

attempt_memory.scope: One search; exact full ordered goal tuple, including all context and names.
attempt_memory.pruning: Heuristic; repeated equal/deeper prefixes may be skipped. No completeness claim.
attempt_memory.retained_bytes_unit: UTF-8 JSON goal payload; excludes Python object overhead and small metadata.

contract.name: context-alpha-v1
contract.authority: one-search; explicit finite commands; no theorem imports
contract.key: exact native DAG bytes; closed target; ordered goals/context slots; full partial certificate; primitive-step count
contract.renaming: surface variable/hypothesis aliases and unique proof-hole IDs only
contract.excluded: nonempty substitutions; any metavariable; ambiguous/reserved names; malformed/unknown ASTs
contract.fallback: fresh non-merging identity for every declined successor
contract.representative: existing literal-goal priority; retain one original snapshot and command path verbatim
contract.priority: goal count, literal goal-text length, proposal rank, parent rank, original commands
contract.transcript: unchanged literal goals, state_sha256, proposals and commands
contract.proof_acceptance: unchanged original-goal kernel check and Hydra fresh replay
